parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
Optional filter for selecting the list of customizations returned.

The following filters are supported:
| Filter | Description | Allowed Operator | Behavior | Example |
| --- | ---| --- | --- | --- |
| id | Filters on the customization's id | co | Contains - The entire operator value must be a substring of the attribute value for a match. |  id co 'navbar' |
|	|	| eq | Equal - The attribute and operator values must be identical for a match. | id eq 'navbar-logo-url'  |
|	|	| ne | Not Equal - The attribute and operator values are not identical. | id ne 'navbar-logo-url' |

* All operators are case-sensitive and only lowercase is allowed. 
		
		e.g: 
			valid	: eq
			invalid : EQ

* Filters can be combined using the and/or logical operator. 

		e.g: (id co 'navbar' or id eq 'navbar-logo-url')
	
* When used as a query string, the filter parameter value must be URL encoded.		 
	
		e.g: ?filter=(id%20co%20'navbar'%20or%id%20eq%20'navbar-logo-url')

	When using cURL, the same expression can be URL encoded as follows: 

		$ curl -s {$BASE_URL}/iam/v1/customizations?subdomain=foo \
			-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
			-G --data-urlencode "filter=(id co 'navbar' or id eq 'navbar-logo-url')"

parameters.name: skipToken
parameters.description:
An opaque token to be provided when requesting a subsequent page after receiving a partial response. 
Partial responses will include a "nextPage" attribute in their response body, which contains the URL of the next page including the appropriate skipToken.

schema.description:

post.description: Logs out of the session by invalidating the access token.

Proxies request to "https://developer.okta.com/docs/api/resources/oidc/#token" to get access token
and ID token
Given an Okta token in the Authorization header, validates the token and sets a global session token as a cookie in the response.

post.summary: Performs JIT Provisioning actions and modifies claims
post.description:
Handles the Token Inline Hook callback from Okta to perform JIT actions. 
Requires the Okta Token Inline Hook secret to be sent as the Bearer in the request auth header.

patch.description: This endpoint can be used to activate a new user. A new user must be activated before their invitations can be accepted.

example.firstName: Natus cum similique et rerum id maiores.
example.invitationId: In est ut et voluptatem voluptatum iure.

post.description:
Verifies user email address and then sends a password reset email. Intentionally does not return any
information that would confirm or deny the validity of email addresses. Fails normally for temporary network issues.
Matches code to a recent reset attempt and then calls user sync service to set the new password.

client_id.description:
Required if the grant type is "client_credentials".
This specifies the "client_id" that was returned when service app was created.

client_secret.description:
Required if the grant type is "client_credentials".
This specifies the "client_secret" that was returned when service app was created.

code.description:
Required if the grant_type is "authorization_code".
The value should be what was returned from "https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/oidc/#authorize" endpoint.
The code has a lifetime of one minute.

grant_type.description: One of the accepted OAuth v2 grant types.

redirect_uri.description:
Required if the grant_type is "authorization_code".
The value should be what was returned from "https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/oidc/#authorize" endpoint.
The code has a lifetime of one minute.

refresh_token.description:
Token returned from a previous call using an authorization code scoped to
"offline_access", which is the only argument for grant_type="refresh_token".

access_token.description:
JWT asserting user identity.
Access token can be used to request access to user owned resources.

expires_in.description: Expiration time of access token, in seconds.

id_token.description:
JWT containing user info.
This token is granted only for "authorization_code" grant type.

logout_redirect_url.description:
The URL to redirect the user upon logout/session expiry,
for example, the organization's Identity Provider page. By default, upon logout, the user
is redirected to the Flexera One login page.

refresh_token.description:
Token returned when using a code scoped to "offline_access" with
grant_type="authorization_code". It is also echoed back when grant_type="refresh_token".

passwordChanged.description: Date/time user's password was last changed

UserType.description: Identifies the Okta user that the assertion was generated to authenticate, and provides details of their Okta user profile

jwt_header_Authorization.description: Secures requests by requiring a valid JWT token retrieved via Okta Token Inline Hook.

jwt_no_scope_header_Authorization.description: Secures requests by requiring a valid JWT token without scopes.
